scope: Purposive selection from five accessible Hugging Face monthly pages; 19 primary-source setup screens and five actual author-asset pixel inspections, not 19 full-paper visual reviews.
selection_rule: Monthly vote counts prioritize community attention, then diversify benchmark mechanics and inspect selected author figures. Votes are not evidence of scientific or graphic quality.
votes_note: Counts below were visible in the retrieved monthly index pages on the review date, which may be cached. They are not historical month-end counts. Detail pages sometimes differ (e.g. BigCodeBench 50 vs index 47; XLand-100B 89 vs index 88).

papers.title: Reasoning Gym
papers.setup_summary: Configurable task generators produce question, answer and metadata; task-specific verification checks responses, including tasks with multiple valid solutions.
papers.design_inference: Question/answer example cards plus generator configuration and a separate evaluator lane.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of procedural reasoning and new procedural environment library.

papers.title: DeepResearch Bench
papers.setup_summary: Expert research prompts lead to citation-rich reports. Report quality and citation support use complementary evaluation procedures.
papers.design_inference: Separate report-quality rubrics from statement-to-source verification; do not merge them into one unexplained score.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of research reports and new benchmark and evaluation methods.

papers.title: VS-Bench
papers.contribution: new benchmark built from game environments
papers.setup_summary: Cooperative, competitive and mixed-motive games support perception, other-agent action prediction and online decision-making evaluations in v3.
papers.design_inference: Put representative rendered states inside task-family groups; distinguish offline prediction from the online action/observation loop.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of multi-agent visual games and new benchmark built from game environments.

papers.title: SWE-Factory
papers.setup_summary: Issue-resolution data construction recovers test assets, builds executable environments and validates failing-to-passing tests.
papers.design_inference: Draw construction and validation before any model evaluation; represent issue, repository, environment and test outcome as distinct artifacts.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of software engineering and benchmark-construction pipeline.

papers.title: MultiFinBen
papers.contribution: new benchmark with selected existing datasets and new task families
papers.setup_summary: The benchmark covers text, vision and audio across languages, including cross-lingual financial evidence integration and document OCR; task selection accounts for difficulty.
papers.design_inference: Use a modest task taxonomy with one concrete document-to-answer example; encode language/modality separately from difficulty.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of multilingual multimodal finance and new benchmark with selected existing datasets and new task families.

papers.title: Mind2Web 2
papers.setup_summary: Long-horizon browsing tasks require time-sensitive synthesis and citations; task-specific judge agents use tree-structured rubrics for correctness and attribution. Current repository documents caching cited pages.
papers.design_inference: Use an answer with source links as the output artifact; show evaluator-side rubric and webpage snapshot, without implying the solving agent sees grading material.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of web research and new tasks and agent judge.

papers.title: AmbiK
papers.setup_summary: Ambiguous and matched unambiguous kitchen tasks include environment descriptions, clarifying dialogue, user intent and plans.
papers.design_inference: Use two aligned instruction cards linked to the same kitchen scene; display the clarification that disambiguates the goal. Do not imply physical robot execution merely because tasks mention a kitchen.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of embodied planning instructions and new paired benchmark dataset.

papers.title: Creation-MMBench
papers.setup_summary: Image-conditioned creative tasks use instance-specific criteria for response quality and factual consistency with the visual input.
papers.design_inference: Show image and request together, candidate output separately, and a task-specific rubric beside the evaluator.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of multimodal creative tasks and new static benchmark.

papers.title: LEGO-Puzzles
papers.version_read: v4, 2026-08-09; original HF abstract is earlier
papers.setup_summary: The current version distinguishes elementary visual questions from stepwise assembly planning over varying horizons.
papers.design_inference: Represent target shape, available pieces and ordered intermediate assembly states; keep VQA and plan-generation protocols separate.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of spatial reasoning and new visual benchmark.

papers.title: SPIN-Bench
papers.setup_summary: The framework spans PDDL planning, competitive games, cooperative games and multi-agent negotiation; task difficulty varies with action spaces, states and interacting agents.
papers.design_inference: Use parallel task-family examples and an explicit information-sharing boundary; avoid treating all participants as a single agent.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of planning and social reasoning and new benchmark and arena.

papers.title: ProcessBench
papers.setup_summary: A test item contains a stepwise mathematical solution. The model locates the earliest erroneous step or declares all steps correct; human experts supply labels.
papers.design_inference: Use a numbered solution trace with one highlighted first error and a separate gold-label badge, rather than a generic problem-to-answer card.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of reasoning critique and new static benchmark.

papers.title: TheAgentCompany
papers.setup_summary: Agents use browser, code and terminal tools within self-hosted workplace applications and interact with simulated colleagues. Task containers include initialization, instructions and grading.
papers.design_inference: Task-role examples, a concrete application environment, paired action/observation arrows and a worked checkpoint-evaluation strip make the protocol tangible.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of workplace agents and new interactive workplace benchmark.

papers.title: XLand-100B
papers.contribution: new dataset built in reused XLand-MiniGrid environment
papers.setup_summary: The released dataset contains complete learning histories over many tasks in XLand-MiniGrid and supports studying generalization to new tasks.
papers.design_inference: Show task variation and histories across episodes; label the environment as reused and dataset construction as the new contribution.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of in-context reinforcement learning and new dataset built in reused XLand-MiniGrid environment.

papers.title: MMLU-Pro
papers.setup_summary: The benchmark removes weak items, adds reasoning-focused questions and expands answer options relative to MMLU.
papers.design_inference: A before/after question specimen plus filtering/construction branch explains the benchmark change; a fake interaction loop would misdescribe this static evaluation.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of knowledge and reasoning and benchmark revision.

papers.title: BigCodeBench
papers.setup_summary: Function-level programming tasks involve multiple library calls and substantial instructions. Complete and Instruct are alternative prompt forms; generated code is evaluated by execution tests.
papers.design_inference: Preserve one real API signature, required libraries and output contract; put private evaluation tests outside the model-visible problem surface.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of code generation and new static executable benchmark.

papers.title: CRAG
papers.contribution: new benchmark and mock retrieval APIs
papers.setup_summary: Factual questions vary in domain, temporal dynamism, popularity and complexity; mock APIs simulate web and knowledge-graph search.
papers.design_inference: Draw controlled retrieval surfaces and answer evaluation separately; label simulated retrieval rather than suggesting unrestricted live browsing.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of retrieval-augmented question answering and new benchmark and mock retrieval APIs.

papers.title: DAComp
papers.setup_summary: Engineering tasks cover architecture, implementation and evolution of repository-level data pipelines; analysis tasks demand open-ended business insights. Execution-based and rubric-based evaluators differ by task family.
papers.design_inference: Carry one business need through design specification, SQL files, updated pipeline and report; match output type to the appropriate evaluator.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of enterprise data workflows and new benchmark.

papers.title: Envision
papers.setup_summary: Four-stage prompts ask for causally ordered image sequences; evaluation combines consistency, physicality and aesthetics.
papers.design_inference: Use a time-ordered strip of frames with shared entities and one changed state per step; separate temporal causality from image beauty.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of causal multimodal generation and new static generation benchmark.

papers.title: NL2Repo-Bench
papers.setup_summary: A requirements document and empty workspace are inputs; the agent must build an installable multi-module Python library that is checked by tests.
papers.design_inference: Show the initial empty workspace, growing file structure, installation and withheld tests; distinguish this from patching an existing repository.
papers.selection_reason: Visible monthly-index attention plus coverage of repository generation and new coding-agent benchmark.

limitations: Most selected papers were screened at abstract/setup level; exact budgets, splits, task counts and metrics require full protocol verification before drawing a figure for those papers.
DeepResearch Bench pics/framework.png returned an empty payload through the connector; no pixel-review claim is made.
Hugging Face paper summaries can lag revised papers. VS-Bench and LEGO-Puzzles demonstrate substantial version changes.
No month was exhaustively screened beyond the accessible index content; this is a diverse convenience sample, not a ranking of all best figures.
Primary author assets are cited and fingerprinted but not redistributed.
